quotes.text: A violent temper is such a terrible, corrosive thing. And the tragedy is that it accomplishes no good; it only feeds evil with resentment and rebellion and pain. To any man or boy within the sound of my voice who has trouble controlling his tongue, may I suggest that you plead with the Lord for the strength to overcome your weakness, that you apologize to those you have offended, and that you marshal within yourselves the power to discipline your tongue.
quotes.speaker: Gordon B. Hinckley
quotes.attr: Gordon B. Hinckley, "Our Solemn Responsibilities," Ensign, Nov. 1991, 51
